description: Synthetic, developer-authored. A maintenance engagement with two proposals, one signed agreement that states who pays what and who signed, and two invoices that share one amount under different records. No real organisation or person.

docs.name: 01_proposal_v1.txt
docs.text:
Harbor Logistics - Maintenance Proposal v1
Date: 2026-03-02. Type: proposal.
Harbor Logistics proposes a maintenance retainer of $18,000 per quarter for Calder Foods.
This proposal is an offer, not an agreement.

docs.name: 02_proposal_v2.txt
docs.text:
Harbor Logistics - Maintenance Proposal v2
Date: 2026-03-20. Type: revised proposal.
The revised maintenance retainer is $15,500 per quarter.
The revised retainer is subject to Calder Foods finance approval and is not yet approved.

docs.name: 03_signed_agreement.txt
docs.text:
Maintenance Agreement - Harbor Logistics and Calder Foods
Date: 2026-04-10. Type: signed agreement.
The agreed maintenance retainer is $16,200 per quarter.
Calder Foods pays the maintenance retainer to Harbor Logistics.
Harbor Logistics pays its own travel costs.
Mira Okafor signed this agreement for Calder Foods on 2026-04-10.
